results.title: UnleashX Reviews 2026: Details, Pricing, & Features | G2
results.content:
UnleashX is an AI workforce platform that lets enterprises hire, govern and scale AI employees across their customer operations. Instead of standalone bots, every AI employee on UnleashX has a defined job, approved knowledge and access to the systems it needs, so work moves from the first conversation to a verified, recorded outcome.
Organizations can hire AI employees for roles like sales development, insurance sales, customer onboarding, support, retention, collections, claims intake, renewals, loan origination and recruitment. When a process spans several stages, teams can build their own workforce and orchestrate multiple AI employees that pass work and context between each other and to human teams. [...] AI employees work across voice, chat, video, click-to-call and automated workflows, and integrate with your tools, your CRM and 100+ enterprise systems to read customer records, take action and confirm the result. Routine work runs autonomously within scoped permissions, while anything outside an employee’s authority is routed to a named human owner with the request, completed steps and decision needed. Built-in evaluation and call quality tools let teams test, review and improve each employee before expanding its responsibilities.
UnleashX is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, rated 4.9/5 on G2, and headquartered in Gurugram, India.
